findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.metrics · Private data: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.recover_resource, simulation.delete, scenario.list, simulation.create, simulation.step, simulation.metrics · Public sink: simulation.create, simulation.step, simulation.metrics · Destructive: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.delete, simulation.create, simulation.step.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.metrics · Private data: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.recover_resource, simulation.delete, scenario.list, simulation.create, simulation.step, simulation.metrics · Public sink: simulation.create, simulation.step, simulation.metrics · Destructive: simulation.inject_failure, simulation.delete, simulation.create, simulation.step

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
